predeclared.note: Item 1 (independent re-computation) was done per builder by dedicated verifiers. R3_exam spot-checks what the verifiers flagged or could not reproduce, applies the PREREG adoption rule to every add-on, runs the final exam and writes the forward protocol. No selection variant is run here; every run below is a diagnostic or the pre-registered exam. 2026 is reported only.

predeclared.forward_estimate_method: Inverse-variance (precision) weighted mean of the DEV excess and the 2026 excess. SE of each = annualised NW(20) standard error of the phase-averaged daily excess. DEV input = DEV excess after the devil's programme-wide Bonferroni (HLZ) haircut with N = 1,991 trials (primary); raw DEV and half-DEV as sensitivity. Computed vs 5-seed random (primary), vs EW, and vs 25-seed random.

expected_performance.note: book ~ equal-weight-universe return + lead over equal weight (additive approximation, pre-tax, after 50 bps costs, E0 timing). Market scenarios use the equal-weight tradable universe's realised CAGR in 2023-25, 2026 and 2021-09..2022-12. The range is the 90% interval of the precision-weighted forward estimate vs EW. X3 execution adds the overnight premium on top (2026: +2.1%/yr for random picks).

forward_power.note: Normal approximation. Clean exam = fresh data only (after 2026-10-14), one-sided 5%: confirmed if fresh lead > 1.645 x fresh s.e. Plan rejected if fresh lead < planning estimate - 1.645 x sqrt(fresh s.e.^2 + prior s.e.^2). The posterior rule leans on the in-sample prior and has a 14-16% false-confirm rate at zero edge, so it is only used to update the planning number.

html_tables.title: 7. The final investment process (what the trader does each week)
rows: XR_neumom, 20 days: each day, rank stocks by their next-open-to-20-day-close return after removing what beta, volatility, size (turnover) and 12-1 momentum explain. Top 30% = +1, bottom 30% = -1 (for reporting).
PROD: average rank of 10 LightGBM models (5 seeds x 2 date halves), 55 point-in-time features, retrained once a year on all data up to 22 trading days before 1 January.
NSE EQ-series equities with price >= Rs 20, 20-day turnover >= Rs 2 cr, >= 120 trading days of history, not circuit-locked, ATR 0.5-15%.

One fixed weekday: after the close, rank the universe. Capital is split into 4 sleeves (25% each); each week one sleeve is renewed. A sleeve holds the top 20 names, 1/20 of the sleeve each (about 80 slots, about 74 names held). Hold 20 trading days.

At a sleeve's renewal, keep names that are still in its new top 20; sell the rest and buy the new names in the next morning's opening session (pre-open auction). No stops, no early exits, no volatility-based sizing (all rejected).
Bottom 30% of PROD on the signal day is a do-not-buy list for anything outside the model book (own ideas, tips). Never short it in cash; F&O shorts lost money and are not used.

Fully invested. Holding 80% or 60% (rest in an overnight fund) is allowed purely as a risk-appetite dial; no market-timing governor; a Nifty futures hedge is optional and costs about 8-9%/yr in a rising market.
At most about Rs 20 cr; each order <= 5% of the stock's 20-day median traded value (excess stays in cash).
Budget 0.5% round trip (0.223% statutory + up to 0.14% slippage per side vs the official open); stress test 0.8%.
Weekly dashboard; review if any of: 6-month lead < -5%, 3-month IC < 0.02, 12-month lead < 0. Stop new entries only if the 12-month lead < 0 AND the 3-month IC < 0.02 at the same weekly check.
html_tables.note: Everything except the X3 execution timing was frozen before round 3. X3 is a disclosed post-hoc execution convention; skill is always judged against random picks traded with the same timing.

summary.verdict: The frozen process is alive but unproven. In 2023-25 the PROD book led random picks by +15.3%/yr (t 3.97; robust to the t-stat method: 3.44 with 60 lags, 3.93 on non-overlapping blocks). In the 2026 exam (7 Jan - 7 Oct, 185 days) it made 10.2% annualised (7.4% total), level with the pre-registered 5-seed random book (+0.4%/yr, t 0.06) and +1.9%/yr ahead of the equal-weight universe (t 0.27); not significant. The precision-weighted forward estimate (2023-25 lead after a Bonferroni haircut for ~1991 trials, combined with 2026) is +4.4%/yr vs random picks (s.e. 3.3%; P(>0) 0.90) and +6.9%/yr vs the equal-weight universe. Of 21 add-ons only the X3 execution timing is adopted (as a disclosed post-hoc execution convention, not skill); everything else is rejected. Trade it at <= Rs 20 cr with the C2 kill rule; the clean exam is data after 2026-10-14.

2026 exam (2026-01-07 to 2026-10-07, 185 trading days; CAGR annualised / total; lead per yr with NW t):
- PROD (pre-registered): 10.2% / 7.4%; vs random-5 +0.4% (t 0.06); vs EW +1.9% (t 0.27); vs random-25 +1.8% (t 0.26); maxDD -17.5%; Sharpe 0.56; 80 bps CAGR 6.4%.
- Single model: 13.9% / 10.0%; vs random-5 +3.9% (t 0.60); vs EW +5.3% (t 0.81); maxDD -17.9%.
- 3-seed ensemble: 9.5%; vs random-5 -0.2% (t -0.02); vs EW +1.3%.
- PROD minus single (paired): 2026 -3.5% (t -1.66); DEV -0.5% (t -0.33). Noise; PROD stays (pre-registered).
- Baselines 2026: random-5 10.2%, random-25 8.7%, EW 8.6%, Nifty 500 price -10.9% (TR proxy -9.9%), cash 5.3%.
- Entry-weekday spread of PROD's 2026 lead: -2.8% to +8.1%/yr. Trades 692, hit rate 50.0%, mean net trade +0.95%.
- Adopted X3 execution in 2026 (R3_book, verified): CAGR 12.4%; gain vs E0 +2.1% (t 3.26); vs timing-matched random +0.4% (t 0.06).

Precision-weighted forward estimate (PROD): vs random-5 (pre-declared primary) +4.4%/yr, s.e. 3.3% [inputs: DEV +15.3% -> haircut +5.7% (s.e. 3.8%); 2026 +0.4% (s.e. 6.7%); weight on 2026 0.25]; vs EW +6.9%; vs random-25 +6.8%; sensitivity vs random-5: upper trial count +3.3%, no haircut +11.6%. 2026 sits -1.92 s.e. from the raw DEV lead and -0.68 s.e. from the haircut one.
summary.final_process:
LABEL: XR_neumom, h = 20 - per date, the rank of the executable 20-day return (open t+1 to close t+20, corporate-action adjusted) after OLS-removing shrunk beta, vol_20, log turnover and 12-1 momentum among elig_base; classes 30/40/30 for reporting only.
SCORE: PROD = mean per-date percentile rank of 10 LightGBM regressors (seeds 1-5 x date offsets 0/1) on 55 point-in-time features; annual walk-forward retrain.
UNIVERSE: elig_base - NSE EQ-series equities, raw price >= Rs 20, 20-day turnover >= Rs 2 cr, >= 120 bars, not locked, ATR 0.5-15%.
BOOK: one fixed weekday, signal after the close; 4 sleeves of 25% each, one renewed per week; each sleeve holds its top-20 PROD names at 1/20 of the sleeve (unfilled slots in cash); 20-trading-day holds; about 74 names across 80 slots, about 39 orders a week, 986 round trips a year.
ENTRIES/EXITS (X3, adopted): at a sleeve's renewal keep names still in its new top-20; sell the others and buy the new names in the next morning's opening session; forced exit at the last valid close on suspension/label_block. No stops, no early avoid-tail exits, no inverse-vol sizing (all rejected).
AVOID VETO (-1 side): bottom 30% of PROD on the signal date is a do-not-buy/exit list for any name outside the model book; the frozen top-20 never holds such names. Never short in cash; no F&O single-stock shorts, long/short or short overlay (all lost money or failed the rule).
EXPOSURE/HEDGE: 100% invested. A static 80%/60% (rest in an overnight fund) is allowed only as a risk-appetite dial (Sharpe vs cash unchanged); no breadth governor; a Nifty 50 futures hedge is an optional risk dial outside the core, not adopted.
CAPACITY: <= Rs 20 cr AUM (about Rs 25 lakh per name); each order <= 5% of the 20-day median traded value, excess stays in cash. Frozen-book crossing vs a dividend-inclusive Nifty 500 is about Rs 20.8 cr (Rs 19.2 cr with the cap).
COSTS: budget 50 bps round trip (statutory 22.3 bps + 13.85 bps/side slippage vs the official open); stress 80 bps.
MONITORING/KILL: weekly dashboard (matured rank IC, top-20 relative/absolute hit, top-20 lead over the universe, avoid-tail return, overlap/turnover, slippage vs official open, overnight gap of names sold). Review if 6-month lead < -5% (K1) or 3-month matured IC < 0.02 (K2) or 12-month lead < 0 (K3); kill (stop new entries, let sleeves run off) if K3 and K2 fire at the same weekly check (C2).
summary.expected_performance: Edge: forward lead over random picks of the same style +4.4%/yr (pre-declared primary; 90% range -1.1% to +9.9%; P(>0) 0.90); over the equal-weight universe +6.9%/yr (90% range +1.6% to +12.2%). Absolute (pre-tax, after 50 bps, additive): if the market repeats 2023-25 (EW 11.2%) the book makes about 15.6%-18.1%; a 2026-like year (EW 8.6%) about 13.0%-15.5%; a 2021-22-like period (EW -2.5%) about 1.9%-4.4%. X3 opening-session execution adds the overnight premium: +3.2%/yr (2023-25) and +2.1%/yr (2026) on random picks, and shrinking. Costs already deducted: 6.2%/yr; short-term capital-gains tax incl. cess costs a further 4.2%/yr (5.0% with X3). Risk: worst fall 2023-25 -26.8%, 2026 -17.5%; median worst fall over 2 years -21.0%, P(deeper than -30%) 0.18; P(losing 12 months) 0.22; P(trailing random picks in a calendar year, live single schedule) 0.26; a dead book still shows a > +5% lead in 0.24 of years.
summary.forward_protocol:
1 FROZEN SPEC: label results/R3_devil/label_h20_neumom.npz recipe; PROD recipe (build_prod.py: 10 walk_forward2 regressors, y = pct - 0.5, seeds 1-5 x date_offset 0/1, date_step 2, default parameters, 55 features); book as in the final process with X3 execution for the live account; costs 50/80 bps; liq2 universe; avoid list = bottom 30%; 100% exposure; no hedge, no regime layer, no event sleeve.
2 CLOCK: fresh data = signal dates from 2026-10-15; first fresh entries at the next open. The lab recomputes weekly, phase-averaged: the E0 PROD paper book (the exam book), the X3 PROD book (live timing), random top-20 with 25 seeds under both timings, the EW universe, Nifty 500 price and a +1.2%/yr total-return proxy. The live account (one entry weekday) is reported alongside.
3 RETRAIN: once a year in the first week of January (first: Jan 2027), identical recipe: train rows 2021-09-01 to 22 trading days before 1 January, same 10 members, no feature/parameter/label change. Before the first retrain, re-fit the 2026 fold and check its scores against prod_h20.npz; log any data fix. Until then score new rows with the 2026-fold recipe.
4 SUCCESS: primary statistic = fresh annualised lead of the E0 PROD paper book vs 25-seed random (secondary: vs EW), NW(20) t, at each annual review. Confirmed if one-sided t >= 1.645 (5% false-confirm at zero edge); power at the planning edge +4.4%: 0.15 at 12 months, 0.22 at 24, 0.34 at 48 (at +6.9%: 0.40 at 24, 0.62 at 48). Plan rejected if the fresh lead < plan - 1.645 x sqrt(fresh s.e.^2 + 3.3%^2) (threshold -5.5%/yr at 24 months): then the planning number becomes the updated posterior, and a posterior <= 0 stops the strategy. The planning number is updated each year by precision weighting (prior + fresh).
5 KILL/REVIEW: review on K1/K2/K3 (any review within 24 months for a good book 0.72); kill on C2 (false alarm for a good book 0.076; detection of a dead book 0.855, median 255 trading days). K3 is likely to trigger a review by 31-Mar-2027 (P 0.6445). Operations: 3-month average slippage vs the official open > 13.85 bps/side -> review; > 28.85 bps/side -> stop adding capital. X3 check: if the 6-month mean overnight gap of names sold turns negative, revert to E0 close exits.
6 CHALLENGERS (shadow only, fresh data only): single model, 3-seed ensemble, E2w avoid-tail weekly exit, liq5 universe. Promotion after >= 24 months only if the paired fresh lead over PROD has t >= 2.24 (Bonferroni, 4 challengers) and maxDD is not > 3 pp deeper.

report_md:
# R3_exam: adversarial verification, final exam, adoption, forward protocol

All numbers are in `results/R3_exam/results.json`. Scripts: `e0_predeclare.py` (pre-declaration, saved first), `e1_exam.py` (exam, SC1, SC2, SC4, SC5, forward estimate), `e2_final.py` (adoption, SC3, SC6, imports, expectations, power, tables, charts), `e3_report.py` (this text). Logs: `log_e*.txt`. Daily series: `exam_series.npz`.

## Verdict
The frozen process is alive but unproven. In 2023-25 the PROD book led random picks by +15.3%/yr (t 3.97; robust to the t-stat method: 3.44 with 60 lags, 3.93 on non-overlapping blocks). In the 2026 exam (7 Jan - 7 Oct, 185 days) it made 10.2% annualised (7.4% total), level with the pre-registered 5-seed random book (+0.4%/yr, t 0.06) and +1.9%/yr ahead of the equal-weight universe (t 0.27); not significant. The precision-weighted forward estimate (2023-25 lead after a Bonferroni haircut for ~1991 trials, combined with 2026) is +4.4%/yr vs random picks (s.e. 3.3%; P(>0) 0.90) and +6.9%/yr vs the equal-weight universe. Of 21 add-ons only the X3 execution timing is adopted (as a disclosed post-hoc execution convention, not skill); everything else is rejected. Trade it at <= Rs 20 cr with the C2 kill rule; the clean exam is data after 2026-10-14.

## 1. Verification (item 1 by the verifiers; my spot-checks)
All four verifiers reproduced the builders' headline numbers with their own code and found no look-ahead. I re-ran what they flagged:
- SC1: R3_verify_R3_scen: random baseline not reproduced by an independent 100-book simulator (seed noise) -> confirmed: the pre-registered 5-seed random sits above its expectation (25-seed and EW agree); PROD's 2026 excess is about +1.8%/yr against the better baseline instead of +0.4%; still far from significant
- SC2: R3_verify_R3_twoway: D0 passes only against EW, not against the frozen book -> confirmed: D0 vs EW DEV +3.39%/yr (t 3.51), 2026 +1.48% (t 1.07); D0 minus frozen book DEV -12.66%/yr (t -3.83). The avoid list is a veto, not an add-on
- SC3: R3_verify_R3_twoway: 'Sharpe unchanged' with index hedges holds only for raw Sharpe -> confirmed: in excess of cash the hedges lower DEV Sharpe (BASE 1.15 vs D1a 1.05, D1b 0.95)
- SC4: R3_verify_R3_scen: NW lag-20 t can be inflated on overlapping data -> book-level t is robust: DEV 3.97 (lag 20), 3.64 (40), 3.44 (60), 3.93 non-overlapping; 2026 near 0 under every choice
- SC5: R3_verify_R3_risk: a live single-phase book is noisier than the phase average -> confirmed: single-phase tracking error about 7.1% (DEV) and 7.7% (2026) vs 6.4% / 7.1% phase-averaged; quote client odds with the single-phase numbers
- SC6: R3_verify_R3_book: Nifty 500 is a price index; capacity crossings should use a dividend proxy -> confirmed: DEV TR proxy 17.99% (price 16.59%); the frozen book's DEV capacity against a dividend-inclusive Nifty 500 is about Rs 19-21 cr
- SC7: all verifiers: headline book numbers -> exact (max abs daily diff 0.0); PROD DEV +15.30%/yr (t 3.97), 2026 +0.41%/yr (t 0.06) reproduced

## 2. Adoption rule on every add-on (DEV only; 2026 reported)
Rule: adopt iff pre-declared (or disclosed extra) AND executable AND DEV paired NW t >= 2 AND maxDD worsens by <= 3 pp (dev_maxdd_change >= -0.03; positive = shallower drawdown). 21 add-ons judged; 3 pass the numeric thresholds (X1, E1, X3).
- **Adopted:** X3 executable carry, as the execution convention. It is the only executable form of the pre-declared E1 (any carry decision made with the close-g signal can only trade at open g+1). DEV gain +3.84%/yr (t 12.66), maxDD -26.77% vs -26.85%. But random picks gain +3.24%/yr from the same timing; X3's lead over a timing-matched random book is +15.9% (DEV) and +0.4% (2026), the same skill as E0. Disclosed post-hoc.
- **Passes, immaterial:** X1 (idle cash at the overnight rate): about +0.01%/yr.
- **Rejected:** E1 (not executable), E2w, E2d, E3, S1, D1a, D1b, D1c, D2 x4, X1-beta, D3, D4, X80, X60, G50.
- **D0 (avoid veto):** vs EW it adds +3.39%/yr (t 3.51); vs the frozen book -12.7% (t -3.83). It is the avoid list already in the frozen process, not an add-on.

## 3. Final exam
Frozen E0 book (weekly, 4 sleeves, top-20 PROD, 20-day hold, liq2, 50 bps), phase-averaged over 5 entry weekdays.
2026 exam (2026-01-07 to 2026-10-07, 185 trading days; CAGR annualised / total; lead per yr with NW t):
- PROD (pre-registered): 10.2% / 7.4%; vs random-5 +0.4% (t 0.06); vs EW +1.9% (t 0.27); vs random-25 +1.8% (t 0.26); maxDD -17.5%; Sharpe 0.56; 80 bps CAGR 6.4%.
- Single model: 13.9% / 10.0%; vs random-5 +3.9% (t 0.60); vs EW +5.3% (t 0.81); maxDD -17.9%.
- 3-seed ensemble: 9.5%; vs random-5 -0.2% (t -0.02); vs EW +1.3%.
- PROD minus single (paired): 2026 -3.5% (t -1.66); DEV -0.5% (t -0.33). Noise; PROD stays (pre-registered).
- Baselines 2026: random-5 10.2%, random-25 8.7%, EW 8.6%, Nifty 500 price -10.9% (TR proxy -9.9%), cash 5.3%.
- Entry-weekday spread of PROD's 2026 lead: -2.8% to +8.1%/yr. Trades 692, hit rate 50.0%, mean net trade +0.95%.
- Adopted X3 execution in 2026 (R3_book, verified): CAGR 12.4%; gain vs E0 +2.1% (t 3.26); vs timing-matched random +0.4% (t 0.06).
DEV reference (2023-25): PROD 30.3%, lead vs random-5 +15.3% (t 3.97), vs EW +16.1% (t 4.39), vs random-25 +16.1% (t 4.38); single +15.8% (t 4.11); random-5 12.0%, random-25 11.2%, EW 11.2%.
Precision-weighted forward estimate (PROD): vs random-5 (pre-declared primary) +4.4%/yr, s.e. 3.3% [inputs: DEV +15.3% -> haircut +5.7% (s.e. 3.8%); 2026 +0.4% (s.e. 6.7%); weight on 2026 0.25]; vs EW +6.9%; vs random-25 +6.8%; sensitivity vs random-5: upper trial count +3.3%, no haircut +11.6%. 2026 sits -1.92 s.e. from the raw DEV lead and -0.68 s.e. from the haircut one.

## 4. Final investment process
LABEL: XR_neumom, h = 20 - per date, the rank of the executable 20-day return (open t+1 to close t+20, corporate-action adjusted) after OLS-removing shrunk beta, vol_20, log turnover and 12-1 momentum among elig_base; classes 30/40/30 for reporting only.
SCORE: PROD = mean per-date percentile rank of 10 LightGBM regressors (seeds 1-5 x date offsets 0/1) on 55 point-in-time features; annual walk-forward retrain.
UNIVERSE: elig_base - NSE EQ-series equities, raw price >= Rs 20, 20-day turnover >= Rs 2 cr, >= 120 bars, not locked, ATR 0.5-15%.
BOOK: one fixed weekday, signal after the close; 4 sleeves of 25% each, one renewed per week; each sleeve holds its top-20 PROD names at 1/20 of the sleeve (unfilled slots in cash); 20-trading-day holds; about 74 names across 80 slots, about 39 orders a week, 986 round trips a year.
ENTRIES/EXITS (X3, adopted): at a sleeve's renewal keep names still in its new top-20; sell the others and buy the new names in the next morning's opening session; forced exit at the last valid close on suspension/label_block. No stops, no early avoid-tail exits, no inverse-vol sizing (all rejected).
AVOID VETO (-1 side): bottom 30% of PROD on the signal date is a do-not-buy/exit list for any name outside the model book; the frozen top-20 never holds such names. Never short in cash; no F&O single-stock shorts, long/short or short overlay (all lost money or failed the rule).
EXPOSURE/HEDGE: 100% invested. A static 80%/60% (rest in an overnight fund) is allowed only as a risk-appetite dial (Sharpe vs cash unchanged); no breadth governor; a Nifty 50 futures hedge is an optional risk dial outside the core, not adopted.
CAPACITY: <= Rs 20 cr AUM (about Rs 25 lakh per name); each order <= 5% of the 20-day median traded value, excess stays in cash. Frozen-book crossing vs a dividend-inclusive Nifty 500 is about Rs 20.8 cr (Rs 19.2 cr with the cap).
COSTS: budget 50 bps round trip (statutory 22.3 bps + 13.85 bps/side slippage vs the official open); stress 80 bps.
MONITORING/KILL: weekly dashboard (matured rank IC, top-20 relative/absolute hit, top-20 lead over the universe, avoid-tail return, overlap/turnover, slippage vs official open, overnight gap of names sold). Review if 6-month lead < -5% (K1) or 3-month matured IC < 0.02 (K2) or 12-month lead < 0 (K3); kill (stop new entries, let sleeves run off) if K3 and K2 fire at the same weekly check (C2).

## 5. Expected performance
Edge: forward lead over random picks of the same style +4.4%/yr (pre-declared primary; 90% range -1.1% to +9.9%; P(>0) 0.90); over the equal-weight universe +6.9%/yr (90% range +1.6% to +12.2%). Absolute (pre-tax, after 50 bps, additive): if the market repeats 2023-25 (EW 11.2%) the book makes about 15.6%-18.1%; a 2026-like year (EW 8.6%) about 13.0%-15.5%; a 2021-22-like period (EW -2.5%) about 1.9%-4.4%. X3 opening-session execution adds the overnight premium: +3.2%/yr (2023-25) and +2.1%/yr (2026) on random picks, and shrinking. Costs already deducted: 6.2%/yr; short-term capital-gains tax incl. cess costs a further 4.2%/yr (5.0% with X3). Risk: worst fall 2023-25 -26.8%, 2026 -17.5%; median worst fall over 2 years -21.0%, P(deeper than -30%) 0.18; P(losing 12 months) 0.22; P(trailing random picks in a calendar year, live single schedule) 0.26; a dead book still shows a > +5% lead in 0.24 of years.

## 6. Forward protocol (data after 2026-10-14)
1 FROZEN SPEC: label results/R3_devil/label_h20_neumom.npz recipe; PROD recipe (build_prod.py: 10 walk_forward2 regressors, y = pct - 0.5, seeds 1-5 x date_offset 0/1, date_step 2, default parameters, 55 features); book as in the final process with X3 execution for the live account; costs 50/80 bps; liq2 universe; avoid list = bottom 30%; 100% exposure; no hedge, no regime layer, no event sleeve.
2 CLOCK: fresh data = signal dates from 2026-10-15; first fresh entries at the next open. The lab recomputes weekly, phase-averaged: the E0 PROD paper book (the exam book), the X3 PROD book (live timing), random top-20 with 25 seeds under both timings, the EW universe, Nifty 500 price and a +1.2%/yr total-return proxy. The live account (one entry weekday) is reported alongside.
3 RETRAIN: once a year in the first week of January (first: Jan 2027), identical recipe: train rows 2021-09-01 to 22 trading days before 1 January, same 10 members, no feature/parameter/label change. Before the first retrain, re-fit the 2026 fold and check its scores against prod_h20.npz; log any data fix. Until then score new rows with the 2026-fold recipe.
4 SUCCESS: primary statistic = fresh annualised lead of the E0 PROD paper book vs 25-seed random (secondary: vs EW), NW(20) t, at each annual review. Confirmed if one-sided t >= 1.645 (5% false-confirm at zero edge); power at the planning edge +4.4%: 0.15 at 12 months, 0.22 at 24, 0.34 at 48 (at +6.9%: 0.40 at 24, 0.62 at 48). Plan rejected if the fresh lead < plan - 1.645 x sqrt(fresh s.e.^2 + 3.3%^2) (threshold -5.5%/yr at 24 months): then the planning number becomes the updated posterior, and a posterior <= 0 stops the strategy. The planning number is updated each year by precision weighting (prior + fresh).
5 KILL/REVIEW: review on K1/K2/K3 (any review within 24 months for a good book 0.72); kill on C2 (false alarm for a good book 0.076; detection of a dead book 0.855, median 255 trading days). K3 is likely to trigger a review by 31-Mar-2027 (P 0.6445). Operations: 3-month average slippage vs the official open > 13.85 bps/side -> review; > 28.85 bps/side -> stop adding capital. X3 check: if the 6-month mean overnight gap of names sold turns negative, revert to E0 close exits.
6 CHALLENGERS (shadow only, fresh data only): single model, 3-seed ensemble, E2w avoid-tail weekly exit, liq5 universe. Promotion after >= 24 months only if the paired fresh lead over PROD has t >= 2.24 (Bonferroni, 4 challengers) and maxDD is not > 3 pp deeper.

## Pros
- Every builder number was reproduced by an independent verifier, and my own phase loop equals C.phase_avg exactly (max abs daily diff 0.0).
- The book-level t-stat is robust to the t-stat method, and the PROD lead survives a better 25-seed yardstick.
- Only one add-on is adopted, and its mechanism (the overnight premium) is measured on random picks, so it cannot inflate the skill estimate.
- The forward protocol has pre-computed false-alarm and power numbers, a fast kill rule and Bonferroni-guarded challengers.

## Cons
- The 2026 exam did not show the DEV edge: the lead over the pre-registered yardstick is +0.4%/yr (t 0.06).
- The forward edge is modest (+4.4% to +6.9%/yr) next to 6.2%/yr costs and 4.2%/yr tax.
- Capacity is small (about Rs 20 cr) and confirmation on fresh data will take years.

## Caveats
- 2026 is short (185 trading days) and lightly contaminated (reported in earlier rounds); entry-weekday luck alone moves PROD's 2026 lead from -2.8% to +8.1%/yr.
- The pre-registered 5-seed random yardstick is noisy: it sits +1.4%/yr above the 25-seed book in 2026 and +0.8%/yr in 2023-25, so the primary forward estimate (+4.4%) is the conservative end; vs EW / 25-seed random it is +6.9% / +6.8%.
- The forward estimate depends on the multiple-testing haircut: +3.3% with the upper trial count, +11.6% with no haircut.
- X3 is a disclosed post-hoc execution convention; 0.83 of its 2023-25 gain is the overnight premium that random picks also earn; that premium shrank (exit-name gap +0.34% per night in 2024, +0.13% in 2026) and opening-auction depth is not modelled.
- Capacity is a judgement: the frozen book falls to a dividend-inclusive Nifty 500 at about Rs 20.8 cr in 2023-25 under Y=1 impact; X3 models higher (Rs 42.9 cr) but all its trades sit in the opening session.
- Absolute-return scenarios are additive approximations on history (2023-25 was an unusually strong small-cap period); tax uses the verifier's cess-corrected STCG model, calendar years, and is not advice (frequent trading may be business income).
- Power is low: a +4.4%/yr edge is confirmed by fresh data alone with probability 0.22 after 24 months; the C2 kill rule, not the confirmation test, is the protection against a dead book.
- Nifty 500 is a price index (about 1.2%/yr dividends missing); lab prices include dividends.
- R3_exam ran no selection variants; diagnostics: 3 scores x 2 periods x 2 costs, 200 extra random books (SC1), D0 re-run (SC2), statistics-only checks SC3-SC6. 21 add-ons were judged from the builders' saved, verifier-reproduced numbers.
- REPORT.md is not written as a file because this subagent is instructed not to write report .md files; the report is in results.json section report_md.
